item.title: Yutoku Inari Shrine, Kashima — Guide
item.description: In the town of Kashima on Saga’s Ariake coast stands Yutoku Inari, one of the three great Inari shrines of Japan, dedicated to the deity of prosperity, business and good harvests. Its most striking feature is the main hall, a vast, richly decorated vermilion structure built dramatically on tall stilts against a steep wooded hillside — a stage-like building reminiscent of Kyoto’s Kiyomizu-dera, rising in brilliant red among the greenery. From its elevated verandas there are lovely views over the town and the surrounding plain.
